FINAL LOOK • VISUAL TARGET
Outfit Style Card

Red + Indigo Weekend

A vivid red V-neck does the heavy lifting, while dark wide-leg denim keeps the outfit grounded and polished. Cream woven texture and a beige belt soften the contrast, and the red paisley tote plus red-accent jewelry make the color story feel intentional. The shopping picks below preserve this same visual formula with current, independently researched matches.

WHAT TO BUY FIRST

Prioritize the pieces that make the look

1

Sweater — the bright red V-neck defines the whole outfit.

2

Jeans — the dark high-rise wide-leg silhouette is what keeps it current.

3

Shoes — the light woven texture balances all the red and denim.

4

Bag — it repeats the red and makes the outfit look deliberately styled.

5

Belt — the small beige repeat pulls the shoes into the outfit.

STYLING TIP

Show a little waist.

Do a small front tuck so the belt peeks out. It prevents the relaxed sweater + wide-leg jeans from turning into too much volume, while keeping the look easy rather than fussy.
